_comment: Capability: reminding the right person, and switching when plans change. The approved copy’s ’reminds the right person before Thursday’, dramatised: dentist pickup moves from Rob to Meg mid-afternoon.

messages.text: Reminder: Freya’s dentist today, 3:40 at Northgate. Rob’s on pickup — I’ve nudged him too.
he’s just texted me, stuck at work. can you switch it to me
Done — the reminder’s yours now. Leave by 3:15 and you’re fine. I’ve told Rob he’s off the hook.
